name: Rabia Arabaci
bio: Rabia Arabaci is the Marketing Coordinator at Alphabyte Solutions, where she manages social media presence and content strategy, growing engagement through LinkedIn posts, blogs, newsletters, and targeted campaigns. She creates and delivers marketing collateral and sales enablement materials — case studies, infographics, proposals, and decks — to support business development.

Before joining Alphabyte, Rabia held marketing roles at BlackBerry, BlackBerry IoT-QNX, and Greensaver, where she led product launches, go-to-market strategies, email campaigns, and competitive analysis across cross-functional teams. She holds a BA Honours in Arts & Business from the University of Waterloo with minors in Economics and Digital Arts Communications.
